escena: SCENE (a staged piece for the website, shot in the agency's work room, late afternoon): the camera sits in the VISITOR'S CHAIR, at seated eye level across her desk, and Nexa is on the other side: MOMENT: the instant she has just finished reading the message you sent and lifts her eyes from the phone to you, about to answer — caught mid-movement, not posed. She LOOKS STRAIGHT INTO THE LENS, the phone still in one hand low near the desk with its screen facing her and away from the camera, the other forearm resting on the desk. Her expression is a warm welcome, the one of someone about to say «hola, cuéntame»: a small genuine smile starting, eyebrows slightly raised — never a posed stock smile. Her head stays FRONTAL: both eyes and both eyebrows fully visible, both cheeks visible, the bridge of her nose does not cut across either cheek. She wears the Efeonce piqué polo. The phone is a current flagship with thin bezels, aluminium frame, no logos; its screen, unseen by us, throws a small cool AZURE-BLUE glow onto her fingers and the underside of her hand — the blue of the house, carried by the light of the message. CRITICAL ON LIGHT, and every practical lamp in the room is SWITCHED OFF: the KEY is a large soft window LOW and to the RIGHT of the frame, raking across her so one side of her face is bright and the other falls into open shadow; a second hard white source behind her on the left and LOW cuts a clean RIM along her shoulder and hair, separating her from the wall; both sources are white and neutral, nothing glows warm or amber. THREE PLANES: the out-of-focus near edge of the visitor's side of the desk at the very front; Nexa sharp in the middle; behind her, far out of focus, a BARE warm-grey plaster wall with one framed print catching the rim — NO plants, NO books, NO shelves, NO mugs, NO lamps, nothing else on or against that wall. She sits LOW and to the RIGHT: her face is centred at about 62% of the frame width, and the very top of her head is at or BELOW 38% of the frame height, and the TOP THIRD of the picture is that calm plaster wall, unbroken. Everything is unbranded except her polo. Seated eye level, 85mm at f/2, focus on her eyes. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this vertical photo sits in the right column of a full-screen menu whose dark panel overlaps its LEFT third with a large curved corner at the top; so the SUBJECT and everything that carries the idea sits in the CENTRE-RIGHT of the frame, and the left third is calm continuation of the same scene, never empty and never a flat slab.

lecho.objeto: the dark matte edge of the visitor's side of the desk with the visitor's own closed notebook on it, crossing the bottom of the frame a hand's width from the lens and dissolved completely out of focus, OUTSIDE every light
lecho.tono: NEAR-BLACK, even across its width, with no highlight, no reflection and no lettering
